title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Full Stack Developer – São Paulo (On-site)

Employment Type: 1-Year Contract

Seniority Level: Associate

Industry: IT Services & Consulting / Technology / Information & Media


Role Overview


We’re looking for an experienced Full Stack Developer to build and maintain tools and infrastructure for UX workflows. This position combines hands-on engineering with strong cross-functional collaboration.


Key Responsibilities

  • Prototyping: Develop high-fidelity, interactive prototypes using Polygon Studio for user feedback.
  • Asset & Template Management: Create and maintain shared asset repositories and design templates.
  • Component Library Development: Build reusable UI components in Lit/React for efficiency and consistency.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with stakeholders, including design, sales, and operations teams, on requirements and project updates.
  • Technical Implementation: Ensure cross-browser compatibility, performance, and write clean, documented code.
  • Platform Expertise: Develop deep knowledge of the Polygon platform.
  • User Onboarding & Support: Provide support and guidance to new users on the Formats Infrastructure.
  • Advertisement Campaign Support: Collaborate with internal teams to design and implement advertising features/campaigns aligned with product goals.
  • Operations Enablement: Partner with operations teams to streamline deployment, process workflows, and performance monitoring of delivered solutions.


Required Skills & Experience

  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in Full Stack Development (mandatory).
  • Mandatory experience in Advertisement and Operations environments, with a proven ability to work cross-functionally to deliver integrated solutions.
  • Proficiency in front-end development (HTML, CSS/SASS, JavaScript/TypeScript).
  • Experience with modern web frameworks (e.G., Angular, React, Lit).
  • Skills in building responsive component libraries.
  • Ability to develop high-fidelity interactive prototypes.
  • Experience with design systems (e.G., Material UI).
  • Knowledge of version control and collaboration tools (e.G., Git).
  • Understanding of UX principles and user-centered design.
  • Experience with AngularJS applications (single-page, complex data-driven interfaces).
  • CSS proficiency (Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS, SASS, LESS).
  • Full stack development capabilities (Node.Js, Python, Java, .NET).
  • Database knowledge (SQL, NoSQL).
  • Proven sales experience and ability to collaborate with sales teams to understand client needs and support solution selling.

title: Supervisor De Cliente
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Que tal entrar para o nosso #TimedeCampeões ?

Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória, é apaixonado por esporte, acredita no trabalho em equipe e está disposto a correr junto com os nossos clientes.

Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória!

Queremos te fazer um convite, mas só se você tiver garra e paixão por vencer! Você jogará na posição do time técnico, inspirando os nossos jogadores na marcação daquele golaço, além de garantir a execução dos padrões de exposição e organização, desenvolver o time de área e garantir alcance de resultados.


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES


Para entrar em campo nesta posição, você precisa:

  • Coordenar, acompanhar, treinar e orientar a equipe na realização das tarefas, garantindo que o padrão de atendimento seja seguido, fornecendo feedback diários com relação ao atendimento e ao desempenho, visando a melhoria contínua no alcance dos resultados.
  • Efetuar a gestão de estoque do setor, analisando o desempenho dos produtos, visando, assim, propor abertura e/ou adequação dos limites.
  • Realizar conferência qualitativa e quantitativa do setor, garantir que todos os produtos do setor estejam com preços marcados corretamente.
  • Realizar diariamente a reunião de time e acompanhar o desempenho de acordo com as metas diárias, visando atingir os resultados propostos.
  • Fazer os acompanhamentos administrativos (pontos, escalas, folgas, horas extras, advertências, entre outros), junto aos atletas liderados, de acordo com normas e procedimentos internos.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES ✅ ✅


Pra jogar bonito você precisa ter:


  • Ensino superior em andamento ou completo
  • Experiência na área de vendas
  • Conhecimento e vivência com gestão de times, visando engajamento e motivação

SOBRE A CENTAURO:


A Centauro é a maior empresa de artigos esportivos da América Latina. Nossa maior missão é mobilizar pessoas e transformar vidas por meio do esporte, por isso, nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória, que iniciou em 1981 e resultou em nossas mais de 220 lojas, presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil.

Por aqui, cada jogada é ensaiada e nossos craques contam com técnicos, líderes de lojas e todas as ferramentas necessárias para uma visão estratégica de jogo!

O clima em loja é de descontração, mas quando chega a hora da partida, cada craque veste a camisa da sua posição e joga junto dos clientes. E se você precisar de ajuda, saiba que nosso time #jogaentrosado , afinal, aqui #miramosotopo.

Muito mais que uma loja, a Centauro é um lugar de histórias escritas por vencedores. Vem fazer seu nome, vem fazer parte do nosso #TimeDeCampeões!

title: Internal Control Coordinator
description:
Ready to lead the risk management and compliance agenda across Latin America? As an Internal Controls Coordinator at Kellanova, you will play a pivotal role in identifying and mitigating financial risks through a strong internal control framework. Your expertise will ensure robust compliance with SOX requirements, corporate standards, and risk mitigation practices—while partnering with senior leaders to strengthen our control culture across the region.



This is a fantastic opportunity to work with cross-functional teams, lead high-impact assessments, manage control reporting, and influence strategic decisions that protect the integrity of our operations in a dynamic and collaborative environment.



A Taste of What You’ll Be Doing

  • Conduct Regional Control Assessments – Perform periodic reviews of process and procedural compliance across the LA region, ensuring risks are identified early and mitigated effectively.
  • Drive SOX Compliance – Lead execution and documentation of Key Financial Controls (KFCs), including testing and reporting deliverables in line with SOX 404 requirements.
  • Manage Control Reporting & Analysis – Consolidate and analyze control results, provide regular updates to key stakeholders, and identify trends and areas of improvement.
  • Oversee Remediation & Compliance – Track and follow up on action plans, ensuring timely and effective remediation of identified control deficiencies and gaps.
  • Lead Stakeholder Engagement – Collaborate with Finance VPs, General Managers, Global Control leaders, and GBS partners to drive control awareness and compliance excellence across the region.


We’re Looking for Someone With

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.
  • 5+ years of experience in internal controls, SOX compliance, or audit within multinational environments.
  • Fluent English (spoken and written) and Advanced Spanish.
  • Proven experience managing teams and leading through influence.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and presentation skills with high attention to detail.
  • Working knowledge of GAAP and Microsoft Excel;
    SAP experience is preferred.
  • Proactive mindset, with the ability to work across multiple countries, cultures, and time zones.



What’s Next


After you apply, your application will be reviewed by a real recruiter, so it may take us a few weeks to get back with you by email or phone. Visit our How We Hire page to get insights into our hiring process and more about what we offer.


If you join our team, you’ll be rewarded for the difference you make. Our comprehensive benefits offer you the support you need through your life events, big or small. Visit our benefits page & be sure to ask your recruiter for more specific information.



Get to Know Us

At Kellanova, we are driven by our vision to be the world’s best-performing snacks-led powerhouse, unleashing the full potential of our differentiated brands and our passionate people. Our portfolio of iconic, world-class brands include Pringles, Cheez-It, Pop-Tarts, MorningStar Farms, Special K, Krave, Zucaritas, Tresor, Crunchy Nut, among others.

Kellanova’s Culture of Best means we bring our best to all that we do in pursuit of our vision to be the world’s best performing snacks-led powerhouse. Our culture celebrates boldness and empowers our people to challenge the status quo, achieve results, and win together.Our focus on Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion (ED&I) enables us to build a culture of belonging where all employees have a place at the table and are inspired to share their passion, talents and ideas to work.

Mars has agreed to acquire Kellanova in a combination that will shape the future of snacking! The transaction is anticipated to close towards the end of 2025 (subject to customary closing conditions, including regulatory approvals). The companies remain separate until closing.

title: Customer Support Technician (Hardware & Software)
description:
Are you a proactive technical support professional with a passion for medical aesthetic technology?


Quartier Latin is a rapidly expanding importer and distributor of cutting-edge medical aesthetic equipment in Brazil, and we are in an exciting phase of growth! Following the consolidated success of our 2D/3D imaging camera and its analysis software, we have expanded our portfolio with the addition of an advanced cryolipolysis device.


We are looking for a versatile Customer Support Technician to join our team in São Paulo, SP, Brazil . This is a crucial position responsible for providing specialized technical assistance, training, and maintenance for both our advanced 2D/3D analysis systems and our new cryolipolysis devices. You will be a key player in ensuring the success and satisfaction of our customers across Brazil and Latin America.


What You'll Do:

  • Provide comprehensive technical support (remote and, when necessary, on-site) for the 2D/3D imaging software (installation, calibration, analysis) and for the cryolipolysis equipment (operation, fault diagnosis, repairs).
  • Perform practical diagnostics, troubleshooting, and basic to intermediate level maintenance/repairs on hardware components, especially for cryolipolysis devices.
  • Manage software licenses and updates, guiding customers on new functionalities.
  • Collaborate with the Supply Chain department for repair estimates and warranty management.
  • Interface with Marketing, Sales, Production, and R&D teams to provide valuable customer feedback and contribute to continuous product improvement.
  • Develop and deliver product training for customers and distributors.
  • Create and update technical documentation (user manuals, FAQs, troubleshooting guides).
  • Report bugs and critical field information to the Research and Development department.


What We're Looking For:


Essential Experience:

  • Technical Degree completed (technical courses/degrees in Electronics, Mechatronics, IT, Automation, or related fields are a plus).
  • Minimum of 2 years of proven experience in technical support , ideally with electronic equipment and/or specific software.
  • Fluent English (written and spoken) is mandatory for communication with our headquarters in France and global partners.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for both software and hardware.
  • Ability to perform hands-on diagnostics and basic to intermediate level repairs.


Desirable Qualifications:

  • Prior experience in the medical aesthetic industry.
  • Fluent Spanish (written and spoken) will be a significant advantage for supporting our customer base in Latin America.


Personal Attributes:

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Empathy, patience, and calmness under pressure.
  • Proactive, solution-oriented, and highly organized.
  • Strong reading comprehension and active listening skills.


Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a rapidly expanding company at the forefront of medical aesthetic technology.
  • Work with innovative products and a dedicated team.
  • Opportunity to make a significant impact on customer success and product evolution.
  • Dynamic and collaborative work environment.


Location : São Paulo, SP, Brazil.

title: Teste De Componentes Automotivos - Analista
description:
Sobre a oportunidade: O teste de componentes é uma etapa crucial no desenvolvimento de sistemas, focando na avaliação de componentes individuais de hardware e software para garantir sua funcionalidade e segurança. Nesta posição, você terá a oportunidade de colaborar diretamente com nossos colegas da matriz na Alemanha, participando de atividades essenciais para garantir a qualidade e a segurança dos sistemas ADAS. Sua rotina envolverá a preparação e automação de testes, monitoramento de desempenho dos componentes, identificação e reporte de falhas, além da verificação de soluções implementadas.

Você também trabalhará com simulações em bancadas/HiLs (Hardware-in-the-Loop), contribuindo para o desenvolvimento dos módulos ADAS. Essa fase é crucial para testar a interação dos componentes em um ambiente controlado, permitindo ajustes e melhorias antes da integração final no veículo.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Conduzir testes e simulações de módulos ADAS em bancadas/HiLs durante a fase de desenvolvimento.
  • Preparar, automatizar e executar testes, além de reportar falhas e verificar soluções para os problemas identificados.
  • Implementação de casos de teste baseados em requisitos e desenvolvimento constante da automação de testes
  • Utilização de ferramentas para codificar sistemas de teste, capturar traces de diagnóstico e simular estados operacionais


Requisitos e qualificações:

Qualificações necessárias

  • Graduação completa ou próxima de finalizar em: Engenharia Elétrica/Eletrônica, Automotiva, Mecatrônica, Mecânica, Ciência da Computação, tecnólogo em eletrônica automotiva ou afins
  • Inglês avançado
  • Experiência no ramo automotivo com ferramentas de diagnóstico (CANoe/CANalyzer, CANape, ECU-Test)
  • Soft skills: Raciocínio lógico, capacidade analítica e organizacional, proatividade e trabalho em equipe

Qualificações diferenciais

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento do produto no ramo automotivo e/ou conhecimento em módulos eletrônicos e eletrônica automotiva
  • Experiência com teste de sistemas ADAS / ECUs
  • Conhecimento em protocolos de comunicação automotiva
  • Conhecimentos de programação em Python, C++, Vector CAPL
  • Conehcimentos de Matlab / SImulink
  • Certificação ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level / Test Analyst
  • Alemão básico ou intermediário

Department: People & Culture

Headquartered in Nashville, TN, with offices in Milan, Mexico City, and Singapore and sales offices, R&D labs, manufacturing hubs, and distribution centers around the world — our reach is truly global.


At SVP Worldwide, we live our values: Think Like Our Customer, Be Curious and Creative, Include Others and Be Transparent. We’re building a connected, inclusive, and customer-first culture where passionate people can thrive.

Ready to help shape the future of sewing and crafting? Explore your next career move with us today.

You’ll be part of the People & Culture team, serving as a culture champion, experience architect and implementor, and trusted partner to our Latin America Sales Team regional functions. HR Business Partnership:

  • Be a thought partner on org design, team effectiveness, talent planning, and leadership development.

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team.
  • Collaborate on global engagement, culture, and employee development initiatives.
  • Manage facility and office experiences for Sao Paulo and Indaiatuba.

Engagement & Culture:

  • Design and deliver regional engagement programs to retain top talent.
  • Lead culture initiatives aligned with company values.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure intentional and values-driven touchpoints.

Project Management & People Process Initiatives:

  • Support implementation of engagement surveys, performance processes, and succession planning.
  • Lead internal communication and employer strategy for Latin America.

Candidate Experience & Talent Support:

  • Lead end-to-end candidate experience, including outreach and interview logistics.
  • Coordinate video/onsite interviews and ensure professional communication.
  • Enhance Brazil's apprentice and intern programs.

Onboarding & New Hire Experience:

  • Manage the end-to-end onboarding process for new hires in Latam.
  • Act as the main point of contact for new hires from pre-boarding through the first 90 days.

Internal Communications, Employer Branding & Online Presence:

  • Draft and manage new hire bio announcements and organizational updates.
  • Create and publish the monthly internal company newsletter.
  • Monitor and manage employee review insights on platforms like LinkedIn and Glassdoor.

HR Technology/Systems & Employee Resources:

  • Maintain and update the company’s HR portal and answer internal requests.
  • Collaborate to ensure user-friendly internal documentation.
  • Act as a point of contact for employee inquiries related to HR topics.


We Offer You:

  • Benefits: medical and life insurance, food basket (or card), canteen at the factory
  • Profit Sharing Program
  • Hybrid work schedule
  • Work environment that harbors a culture of collaboration and community
  • Learning and development opportunities


REQUIREMENTS AND PERFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or related field required
  • 7+ years of experience in People & Culture, Employee Experience, HR Business Partnership preferably in a fast paced, manufacturing and consumer goods global environment
  • Exceptional communication, facilitation and relationship-building skills - someone who people trust
  • Financial acumen (budget, costs and forecast knowledge)
  • Experience in management or internal communications
  • Passion for engagement, pulse-check platforms and insight tools

title: Senior Key Account Manager
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arab world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.


What You'll Do


  • Responsible for the development and operation of regional chain brands, driving user acquisition and scale growth for assigned brands, leading the team to execute the company's sales strategies, and achieving performance targets;
  • Promote deep collaboration between regional chain brands and the platform in areas such as brand marketing, promotional activities, and user operations, enhancing the partnership and stickiness between the brands and Keeta;
  • Based on the characteristics of the food and beverage industry, develop a deep understanding of categories and brand operation models, identify business development opportunities, and formulate tactical plans covering (but not limited to) growth, marketing, user experience, and membership programs to strengthen Keeta’s influence within the industry;
  • Establish strong communication with the delivery department, acting as a bridge between brands and the platform’s delivery operations, and work collaboratively to continuously optimize the brand delivery service experience;
  • Fully leverage personal work potential, gather frontline marketing information, user feedback, and local market dynamics to provide valuable insights and references for the company's decision-making.


What We Need From You


  • Over 8 years of experience in key account management, channel development, or retail management, with a solid foundation in management methodologies and practices.
  • Strong business negotiation and market expansion skills, with a keen ability to identify client and user needs and a proactive attitude toward challenges.
  • Experienced in process and project management, with the ability to drive multiple tasks and projects concurrently.
  • Highly reliable and resilient, demonstrating strong work enthusiasm and a collaborative team spirit.
  • Fluent in English (speaking, reading, and writing) and capable of using it as a working language;
    proficiency in Portuguese is a strong plus.


Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a clear vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 94 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Tax Manager
description:
Why Valmont


We’re Here to Move the World Forward.


Valmont impacts millions of people around the world every day, yet they might not realize the many ways. Our technology is helping feed the growing population, supplying the world with more reliable energy and access to renewables, enhancing connectivity in remote and urban locations to create a sustainable future and so much more. Simply put, Valmont is advancing agricultural productivity and reimagining vital infrastructure to make life better.


Join a Fortune 1000 company that respects hard work, honors diversity and invests in our employees as we focus on creating the world of tomorrow, today. We are the modern workforce . Are you ready to move the world forward? Apply now.

Why Valmont


A Brief Summary of This Position:


The primary function of this position is to ensure the company’s compliance with Brazil tax laws and regulations and to assist in satisfying its tax filing obligations. The position will involve working with various areas of tax including, but not limited to, federal tax, state and local tax, and ASC 740.The position will assist in helping compile the quarterly and annual tax provision for the company, including gathering data from divisional sources and creating supporting workpapers and preparation of corporate federal and state income tax returns. This position will assist in the administration of the department’s tax provisioning and compliance softwares. The Manager, Tax role requires a working knowledge of current tax laws and a willingness to expand that knowledge base through various resources provided by the company.


Essential Functions:

  • This position reports to the Director Federal Tax and has no direct or indirect reports but could evolve to have direct reports in the future.
  • The role requires up to 5% domestic travel, including overnight stays.


Federal Tax Compliance

  • Assist with the preparation and filing of the corporate federal income tax returns and related work papers.
  • Prepare quarterly federal estimated tax payment.
  • Research transactions of an unusual nature as they arise.
  • Ensure all filing dates are met to satisfy tax compliance obligations.
  • Determine 1099-MISC taxable amounts for the members of the board of directors.
  • File federal withholding forms and deposit payments related to board of directors.


State Tax Compliance

  • Prepare corporate state income tax returns and related work papers.
  • Prepare quarterly state estimated tax payments.
  • Monitor and implement law changes in relevant jurisdictions.
  • Research transactions of an unusual nature as they arise.
  • Review nexus activities by each legal entity on a periodic basis for tax compliance.
  • File Brazil withholding forms and deposit payments related to board of directors.


ASC 740 – Accounting for Income Taxes

  • Compile and review tax accounting work papers on quarterly basis.
  • Collect, analyze, and evaluate data to ensure accurate calculations of income tax liabilities.
  • Prepare quarterly reconciliation workpapers used in ASC 740 analysis.
  • Compile documentation necessary to complete the footnote disclosures in the Company’s financials.
  • Work closely with the company’s external auditors to provide appropriate audit documentation.


Other Important Details about the Role:

  • Utilize tax, analytical, and problem-solving skills while working in a small team environment.
  • Focus on continual improvement to create efficient and lean processes.


Required Qualifications of Every Candidate (Education, Experience, Knowledge, Skills and Abilities):

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Business Administration or relevant field with 6+ years relevant experience or Associates Degree with 8+ years relevant experience or 10+ years of relevant experience.
  • 6+ years experience in a corporate tax department or public accounting firm.
  • Working knowledge of federal, state, local tax laws.
  • Ability to work under constant deadlines and prioritize workload accordingly.
  • Effective communication skills, both written and oral.
  • Energetic and self-motivated team player with ability to work effectively with the small tax team and larger accounting teams.
  • Experience with ASC 740.
  • Advanced knowledge of MS Excel.


Highly Qualified Candidates Will Also Possess These Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree – MBA, MSA or relevant.
  • CPA, CPA equivalent, and/or JD.
  • Experience with Corptax and OneSource tax provision software.

title: Analista Funcional
description:
We are looking for a Functional Analyst to join our Technology department in a financial institution. This professional will be responsible for gathering and analyzing requirements, supporting the implementation of technological solutions that align with the company’s strategic goals. The Functional Analyst will work on large-scale projects, focusing on financial system integrations and process improvements, ensuring that solutions meet both internal and external client expectations.


Who we are at Exadel:


Exadel is a global software consulting and development company that partners with organizations to help them become digital leaders in their industries. We look beyond the code to understand the impact our clients want to make and help them get from ideation to development and outcomes. We accelerate the results of digital transformations through an open, collaborative approach combined with our deep experience across industries, business processes, and technologies.

Exadel Financial Services is the financial arm of our organization, specializing in banking, capital markets strategy and technology consulting. Exadel is committed to service excellence and being a great place to work.

Location :

  • Sao Paulo, Brazil
  • Hybrid, 3 days a week in office


Key Responsibilities:

- Requirements Analysis: Gather and document functional and technical requirements from technology, business, and customer areas, identifying specific needs related to APIs.

- Functional Specifications: Develop and detail documentation of requirements, integrations, and operational flows.

- Development Support: Collaborate with technical teams during system development to clarify questions and adjust specifications.

- Testing and Validation: Build test scripts and evidence, focusing on functional, technical, volumetric, and performance testing to ensure delivery quality.

- System Integrations: Ensure interoperability with trading, back office, and regulatory compliance platforms.

- Backlog Management: Control the project and incident backlog.

- Operations Support: Assist in diagnosing and resolving issues related to implemented systems.

Hard Skills

- Experience in the financial sector in custody, funds, assets, and liabilities.

- Experience with systems development, especially in APIs.

- Ability to query Oracle and SQL Server.

- Degree in Information Technology or Economics/Financial Markets.

- Advanced English (reading, writing, and speaking).


Interpersonal skills:

- Organization and prioritization of activities.

- Sense of ownership of the systems under your care.

- Ability to work in a dynamic environment with multiple demands.

- Ability to negotiate with stakeholders, such as users, customers, and partners.


Differentials:

Experience with Financial Market Custody Systems, such as TOTVS/YMF/Dimensa or Megara.

Advanced knowledge of systems analysis and documentation (UML, BPMN).

Familiarity with Software Factory concepts and financial integrations (FIX, SWIFT).

CPA-20 or CEA certification.

  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

description:
A Hellotext é a plataforma de marketing conversacional e automação que potencializa as vendas das marcas de e-commerce mais ambiciosas da América Latina. Com uma carteira de clientes em rápido crescimento, estamos expandindo nosso time de geração de pipeline país por país — agora é a vez do Brasil.

Gerar um fluxo previsível de marcas brasileiras de porte médio a enterprise, abrir relacionamento com líderes de Marketing (nível C-Level) e construir oportunidades de negócio qualificadas para o time de vendas da Hellotext.

  • Visitar escritórios de marcas-chave em São Paulo, Rio, BH, Porto Alegre ou outras praças estratégicas.

O que você traz


  • 2–5 anos como SDR/BDR ou AE vendendo SaaS/MarTech para varejo ou e-commerce.
  • Histórico comprovado de geração de pipeline (reuniões + valor) no mercado brasileiro.
  • Português nativo e inglês intermediário-avançado;
    domínio diário de Apollo e HubSpot (ou ferramentas equivalentes).
  • Zero medo de telefone e disponibilidade para viajar ≈ 25 % dentro do Brasil.


Diferenciais (nice-to-have)


  • Negócios fechados ≥ USD 30 k ARR.
  • Rede de contatos C-Level em varejo/e-commerce.
  • Experiência mentorando SDRs júnior.


Competências que valorizamos


  1. Prospeção magistral – cold-calling sem desculpas.
  2. Storytelling C-Suite – transforma dados em narrativas claras e convincentes.
  3. Criatividade consultiva – desenha ativações sob medida para marcas top.
  4. Propriedade de pipeline – trata a meta como quota, não só KPI.
  5. Mentalidade de aprendiz – itera, faz A/B tests, compartilha playbooks.


Por que a Hellotext?


  • Produto líder, 100 % focado em comércio eletrônico latino-americano.
  • Time fundacional: impacto direto na estratégia regional.
  • Cultura de propriedade, ação rápida e transparência .
  • Salário R$ 12 000 – 16 000/mês + bônus por metas.
  • Trabalho remoto no Brasil com verba para coworking e visitas a clientes.


Como se candidatar


  1. Complete nosso teste on-line (≈ 60 min).
  2. Anexe seu currículo ao final do teste.
  3. Grave um vídeo de 2 min seguindo as instruções finais.


Seu desempenho será avaliado pessoalmente pelo CEO , então reserve uma hora sem interrupções e dê o melhor de si em uma única sessão.

description:

Garantir a gestão estratégica e operacional do transporte inbound, assegurando eficiência no recebimento de fornecedores, transferências entre as unidades ao menor custo logístico possível, preservando padrões de segurança, qualidade e compliance.

  • Gestão Operacional: Planejar e coordenar transportes inbound, incluindo recebimento de fornecedores, transferências entre unidades e ressuprimento;
  • Planejamento deTransporte: Conduzir projetos estruturantes, desenhar a malha logística e definir requisitos para contratação de transportadoras;
  • Gestão de Fornecedores e Contratações: Negociar com parceiros logísticos, assegurando idoneidade, competitividade e aderência às políticas da companhia;
  • Gestão de Performance: Estruturar e monitorar KPIs de transporte, indicadores de custo, produtividade, segurança e qualidade;
  • Otimização e Inovação: Apoiar estudos de otimização da malha logística e de viabilidade operacional, financeira e ambiental;
  • Integração Interna: Atuar em estreita colaboração com as áreas de S&OP, Operações, Suprimentos e Comercial, fortalecendo a integração e a sinergia entre áreas;
  • Compliance e Sustentabilidade: Garantir aderência a normas legais, treinamentos obrigatórios e políticas de ESG.


Requisitos necessários:


  • Capacidade de liderar times diretos e indiretos, influenciando parceiros internos e externos;
  • Agilidade para adaptação em cenários de mudança, assegurando equilíbrio financeiro frente a custos crescentes;
  • Forte capacidade analítica, orientada a dados e resultados, com foco em melhoria contínua;
  • Habilidade de negociação e gestão de parceiros estratégicos;
  • Atuação colaborativa e integradora em ambientes complexos e multifuncionais;


Requisitos Técnicos:


  • Graduação em Administração, Engenharia, logística ou áreas correlatas (Pós-graduação/MBA será diferencial).
  • Experiência comprovada em operações logísticas inbound e gestão de transporte.

Ser GRAND é viver todos os dias movido pelo propósito de "cuidar das pessoas para que elas possam ser o seu melhor".

Nossa promessa está em entregarmos grandes experiências para nossos clientes, colegas e para a sociedade baseada em nossos valores.

· Respeitamos as pessoas pois cremos que ser inclusivo e valorizar os diversos pontos de vista nos fazem crescer juntos;

· Ser íntegro nostorna diferentes pois estamos prontos para falar e aceitar a verdade, honrando com os compromissos, responsabilidades e orgulho;

· Somos empáticospois antes de qualquer coisa, nos colocamos no lugar das pessoas com compaixão e honestidade;

· Buscamos a todoinstante ver as coisas de uma forma diferente, nos tornando criativos, curiosos e experimentando sem medo. Acreditamos que as falhas existem e são elas que nos levam ao sucesso mais cedo;

· Prezamos por umambiente de descontração, rimos alto e geramos a alegria em nosso ambiente de trabalho. Cultivar um ambiente saudável, alegre e de bem-estar é a chave para um serviço de excelência!

Junte-se a uma das organizações mais amadas e consolidadas do mercado hoteleiro no mundo!

SOBRE A VAGA :


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Auxiliar o atendimento ao cliente;
  • Apoiar as demandas do departamento;


Requisitos da vaga:

  • Inglês avançado/fluente
  • Cursando faculdades voltadas para Hotelaria ou Turismo;
  • Ter disponibilidade para estagiar de 5 a 6 horas por dia, total de 30 horas semanais;
  • Amar, Cuidar e Servir!

Oferecemos uma lista completa de benefícios:

  • Plano de Saúde para o colaborador e até dois dependentes;
  • Plano Odontológico opcional para o colaborador e dependentes;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Vale Transporte de acordo com as suas necessidades;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Uniforme lavado e passado em nossa lavanderia;
  • Café Sampa: O melhor restaurante, exclusivo para as refeições de nossos colaboradores;
  • Focamos no apoio a saúde mental através de uma psicóloga que faz atendimentos presenciais;
  • Gympass para apoio a saúde física;
  • Day off no dia do seu aniversário;
  • Desconto nos serviços oferecidos pelo hotel (Restaurantes e SPA);

E aí, que tal ser GRAND? Cadastre-se e boa sorte!!

title: Gerente De Desenvolvimento E Arquitetura
description:
Somos o grupo educacional mais diversificado do país. Todos os dias, criamos futuros incríveis através da inovação. Colocamos a mão na massa para tirar as ideias do papel e colocá-las em prática. Enfrentamos desafios com resiliência e nos adaptamos às mudanças constantes.


Por aqui, somos um time e não heróis, guiados pela vontade de fazer a diferença e conectados de um só jeito, o #JeitoCogna. Nossa relação é direta e respeitosa, e o sucesso dos nossos alunos e clientes é o nosso sucesso.


Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:

O Gerente de Arquitetura de Soluções irá liderar de forma proativa e holística as atividades da Arquitetura Corporativa que orientam o desenvolvimento e o gerenciamento de soluções técnicas e de infraestrutura. Essas soluções habilitam os recursos de negócios de estado futuro da organização e impulsionam os resultados de negócios direcionados da organização. As tecnologias incluem tecnologias e arquitetura de soluções de aplicações, integrações, dados, infraestrutura e segurança da informação.

O Gerente de Arquitetura de Soluções fornecerá as tarefas de liderança, facilitação, análise e design necessárias para o desenvolvimento das arquiteturas técnicas, ajudando a desenvolver as orientações de estado-alvo (TO-BE) definindo e gerenciando a governança da arquitetura quanto às arquiteturas de referência, padrões e princípios, assim como a gestão do ciclo de vida das tecnologias e serviços e seus impactos junto as capacidades de negócio da Cogna. Será responsável por orquestrar a entrega de resultados de negócios direcionados por meio da facilitação e tomada de decisões técnicas.



● Irá trabalhar com pares da Arquitetura Corporativa (por exemplo, arquitetos corporativos, de negócios, de informações, soluções e de segurança) para analisar o contexto de negócios corporativos (estratégia e tendências de negócios).

● Irá liderar a analisar o ambiente de tecnologia atual para detectar deficiências críticas, dívidas técnicas e legadas e recomendar soluções para melhoria.

● Irá treinar, orientar e colaborar com especialistas nos assuntos técnicos para desenvolver uma arquitetura de tecnologia que habilite e impulsione novos recursos de negócios e modelos operacionais.

● Ajudará a definir planos de migração de alto nível para resolver as lacunas entre o estado futuro e o atual, em sincronia com o orçamento de TI ou outros processos de planejamento de capital.

● Buscará compreende as tendências tecnológicas e a aplicação prática de tecnologias existentes, novas e emergentes para permitir modelos operacionais e de negócios novos e em evolução.

● Orientará as decisões de investimento em tecnologia com base em análise e avaliação para gerar resultados de negócios, garantindo que os requisitos não funcionais sejam atendidos.

● Auxiliará na concepção das atividades de governança, garantindo a aplicação dos padrões associados à garantia da conformidade da arquitetura de tecnologia corporativa de projetos e produtos.

● Irá lidera as mudanças de tecnologia para fornecer resultados de negócios através de um programa de convergência e racionalização das tecnologias existentes.

● Conduzira os comitês de arquitetura com foco na governança da arquitetura e na atuação proativa para concepção de novas arquiteturas de referência, padrões e princípios.

● Atuará como apoio consultivo sobre as atividades de implementação e modificação de tecnologia (por exemplo, projetos e produtos), particularmente para soluções e arquitetura de software, integrações, dados, infraestrutura e segurança da informação.

● Atuará como apoio consultivo nos projetos de desenvolvimento de aplicativos, integrações e infraestrutura para harmonizar sistemas ou infraestrutura com a arquitetura de tecnologia corporativa e identificar quando é necessário modificar a arquitetura de tecnologia para acomodar as necessidades imediatas ou futuras do projeto.

● Trabalhará em estreita colaboração com os gerentes de produto e donos de produtos para permitir agilidade, escalabilidade e resiliência das tecnologias e soluções para atender às necessidades necessárias do produto em todos os ciclos de vida do produto.

● Responsável por garantir os padrões e documentações necessária de design e análise de arquitetura de tecnologia corporativa.



Requisitos e qualificações:


● Graduação ou Bacharelado em ciência da computação, tecnologia da informação ou análise de sistemas.

● Pós-graduação em Arquitetura de Soluções.

● Mínimo de cinco anos de experiência em design e implementação de soluções em TI, com profundo conhecimento em pelo menos duas das seguintes disciplinas técnicas (ou similares): Engenharia de Software, Desenvolvimento de Integrações (APIs/Arquitetura Orientada a eventos – Incluindo plataformas de gerenciamento de APIs), Infraestrutura Cloud e modelos de implementação, tecnologias de clustering e virtualização e Arquitetura de Dados (Tecnologias para armazenamento e processamento de dados estruturados e não estruturados).

● Compreensão do gerenciamento de produtos, princípios ágeis e metodologias de desenvolvimento e capacidade de apoiar equipes ágeis, fornecendo conselhos e orientações sobre oportunidades, impactos e riscos, levando em consideração a dívida técnica e arquitetônica

● Compreensão das metodologias do ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de sistemas (como cascata, espiral, desenvolvimento ágil de software, prototipagem rápida, incremental, sincronização e estabilização e DevOps)



Qualificações


● Excelentes habilidades interpessoais em áreas como trabalho em equipe, facilitação e negociação

● Fortes habilidades de liderança

● Excelentes habilidades analíticas e técnicas

● Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal

● Excelentes habilidades de planejamento e organização

● Conhecimento de muitos, se não da maioria, dos componentes de uma arquitetura de soluções e arquitetura corporativa (TOGAF)

● Conhecimento de gerenciamento de serviços de TI (ITSM / ITL)

● Capacidade de entender as perspectivas de longo prazo ("quadro geral") e de curto prazo das situações e como elas se relacionam com a obtenção de resultados de negócios almejados

● Capacidade de estimar o impacto financeiro de alternativas tecnológicas

● Capacidade de aplicar várias soluções técnicas para habilitar recursos de negócios de estado futuro que, por sua vez, geram resultados de negócios direcionados

● Capacidade de compreender rapidamente as funções e capacidades de tecnologias existentes, novas e emergentes que permitem e impulsionam novos designs e modelos de negócios

● Conhecimento de diferentes linguagens de modelagem (como UML e ArchiMate)



O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.



Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.



Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

description:

  • Superior completo em tecnologia e afins (desejável).
  • Ciência da Computação;
  • Engenharia da Computação;
  • Sistemas de Informação;
  • Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas;
  • Engenharia de Software;


Conhecimento:

  • Sólida experiência em desenvolvimento Front-End com Angular.
  • Profundo conhecimento de HTML, CSS e Typescript.
  • Experiência com testes unitários e de integração.
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de desenvolvimento (SOLID, Clean Code, etc.).
  • Experiência com controle de versão utilizando Git e GitHub.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe e comunicar-se de forma eficaz.
  • Capacidade de resolver problemas de forma criativa e eficiente.

Diferenciais:- Experiência com desenvolvimento Back-End em Python e NodeJS.- Conhecimento em outros frameworks (Next.Js, React, etc.).- Experiência com metodologias ágeis.- Conhecimento em Agentes de IA (LangChain, LangGraph, LLM, RAG, prompt engineering, etc)- Conhecimento de Angular libs e webcomponents.

description:

title: Médico Da Família E Comunidade
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO DE SAÚDE DA FAMÍLIA E COMUNIDADE (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Medicina e Saúde da Família e Comunidade! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


* SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


* O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você Realizará atendimento de orientação médica telefônica através de uma abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde relativos a diferentes gêneros ou grupos etários.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Executar atividade de coordenação do cuidado, identificando situações com necessidade de encaminhamento à equipe de segunda opinião médica, comunicando-se eficientemente com os pacientes e sendo o interlocutor do caso ao gerente de segunda opinião médica.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.



REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO CONCLUÍDA EM MEDICINA DA FAMILIA.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em MEDICINA DA FAMILIA ;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em MEDICINA DA FAMILIA, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;



Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.

title: Supplier Development Engineer
description:
We are looking for a talented and proactive Supplier Development Engineer (SDE) to join our team in Latin America. If you have a passion for the renewable energy industry and experience in ensuring the highest quality standards, this is the opportunity for you!


As a key member of our team, you will be responsible for the entire quality lifecycle of our suppliers in the region, from evaluation and qualification to continuous supervision and problem-solving.


Main Responsibilities:


- Supplier Evaluation & Development: Identify and evaluate new suppliers in cooperation with the Sourcing team to build a competitive and reliable supply chain.

- Quality Audits: Conduct quality system (ISO 9001), process, and product audits to ensure new suppliers and materials meet our stringent requirements.

- Product Approval (PPAP): Manage the sample approval process for new products and complete the material PPAP process, signing off on quality agreements with the R&D department.

- Production Supervision: Oversee supplier production, including incoming materials, manufacturing processes, warehousing, and shipment, and prepare daily supervision and outgoing reports.

- Non-Conformance Management: Promptly address and resolve quality issues from suppliers, ensuring that corrective actions are implemented effectively and tracked until closure.

- Regional Support: Assist in handling quality issues for inventory in Latin America (e.G., packaging, rust, material shortages) and manage project quality complaints by investigating root causes and following up on solutions.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Maintain clear communication with Procurement, Logistics, and Project Management departments.


Job Qualifications:


- Bachelor’s degree in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering. A Master’s degree is preferred.

- 3+ years of work experience, preferably in the PV, new energy, or a related industry.

- Proficient in ISO 9001 quality systems, supplier management, and project quality management.

- Fluent in English (listening, speaking, reading, and writing) is required. Basic communication skills in Chinese are a plus.

- Knowledge of industry standards and experience with solar plants.

- Willingness and ability to travel frequently throughout the Latin America region.

- Target-oriented mindset, self-motivation, and excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

title: Associate Sales Representative Bilingual
description:
The Associate Sales Representative is responsible for demonstrating the value and benefits of our client’s products or services through customer engagement, with a primary focus on selling and/or renewing contracts. This role is responsible for effectively articulating the value of products or services to customers.



The role involves expertise in identifying potential customers and converting them into clients, focusing on the dynamic and rapidly evolving social media and technology sectors in Brazil. You will play a crucial part in expanding Meta's market presence in this vibrant region by understanding local customer behavior and preferences



You will

  • Conduct detailed market assessments to identify potential client segments and tailor acquisition strategies relevant to the Brazilian context.
  • Develop and implement culturally and contextually adapt marketing and outreach strategies in alignment with Meta's branding.
  • Engage with potential clients via various communication platforms including face-to-face meetings, social media platforms, and digital communications to build strong relationships.
  • Collaborate with internal marketing and sales teams to localize content suitable for the Brazilian market.
  • Analyze competitor activities within social media and tech industries to ensure our product offerings stand out.

You have

  • Bachelor's degree in business, Marketing, Sociology, or related field.
  • 1-3 years of experience in customer acquisition roles, preferably within the Brazilian market or for multinational tech firms.
  • Proficiency in Portuguese and English with strong communication and negotiation skills. Spanish communication proficiency is a plus.
  • Understanding of the Brazilian digital marketing landscape, including knowledge of social media trends and platforms predominantly used in Brazil.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant

  • Accounting
  • Part-time, Contract (approx. 20 hours per week)
  • Location: Remote


WHAT IF…

You could help an entire industry become more efficient with technology? At PickTrace, we are digitizing the agriculture industry in a big way, and that’s why we are looking for an Implementations Specialist to join our Implementations team.


We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Senior Accountant or Accounting Manager to join our team on a part-time basis (approximately 20 hours per week). The ideal candidate will be experienced in QuickBooks Online (QBO), Excel, and all core aspects of monthly accounting close processes.


This role will report directly to the Controller . This role will be fully remote.


WHAT WILL YOU DO

Weekly

  • Manage the full Accounts Receivable (AR) cycle:
  • Receive and process client agreements
  • Generate and send 10–20 invoices weekly
  • Maintain AR schedule and support collections (handle complex invoicing schedules)
  • Oversee the full Accounts Payable (AP) cycle:
  • Receive and process vendor bills
  • Route invoices for approval
  • Dispute or follow up on payments when necessary (Bill.Com experience preferred)
  • Perform weekly bank reconciliations
  • Assist with credit card and expense report reconciliation (15 corporate cards, 2 bank accounts)
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Internal Operations, and other teams as needed


Monthly

  • Execute a timely and accurate month-end close (by the 18th of each month), including:
  • Bank reconciliations
  • Prepaid expense schedules
  • Accruals and deferrals
  • Depreciation and amortization schedules
  • Expense reclassifications
  • Identification and analysis of revenue leakage
  • Assist with the preparation of monthly financial statements


WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Proficient in English (written and verbal)
  • Proven experience in accounting and month-end close processes
  • Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online and Excel
  • Familiarity with Bill.Com is a plus
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to work independently and communicate effectively across teams


WORK SCHEDULE

  • Approximately 20 hours per week
  • Availability required 3 times per week between 10:00 AM and 3:00 PM Pacific Time during the initial ramp-up period
  • Post ramp-up: availability 1–2 times per week during the same hours

description:
At Swarovski, where innovation meets inspiration, our people desire to explore, experience, and create. We are looking for an Architecture & Facility Manager where you will get a chance to work in a rewarding role within a diverse team that is pushing boundaries. Be part of a truly iconic global brand, learn and grow with us. We’re bold and inventive, revealing astonishing things like no one else can. A world of wonder awaits you.


About the job


  • Provides advice to Sales and Real Estate teams about technical feasibility, timings, and cost of projects.
  • Personally, or supported by external collaborators, executes kick off meetings and site surveys, develops drawings, collects technical data, and provides briefing (initialization package) to the store planning team including legal and operational requirements.
  • Collects and consolidate layout feedback from the parties (landlord, market, partner), aligned and with concept guidelines and the approved budget.
  • Follow up the defined time schedule to ensure that each activity is organized and monitored in the appropriate sequence for construction and POP opening.
  • Monitor the budget of each project to respect the initial approved amounts.
  • Supervises the external consultants and drive them to achieve the team goals.
  • Performs, personally or though external collaborators, formal handovers to the sales team.
  • Ensures the quality of the implementation and adherence with brand identity.
  • Implement global maintenance procedures, manuals, guidelines, tools and policies to ensure local roll out within defined KPIs in terms of quality and costs.
  • Vendor management (facilities service providers, warehouse, lighting supplier, etc)
  • Perform, personally or through third parties, regular audits to ensure that look & feel of distribution is according to the branding standards.


About you


  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 4 +years of professional experience in a similar role
  • Strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
  • Advanced English language

  • Attractive Conditions for pension funds

Masters of Light Since 1895


Swarovski creates beautiful crystal-based products of impeccable quality and craftsmanship that bring joy and celebrate individuality.


Founded in 1895 in Austria, the company designs, manufactures and sells the world's finest crystal, gemstones, Swarovski Created Diamonds and zirconia, jewelry, and accessories, as well as crystal objects and home accessories. Swarovski Crystal Business has a global reach with approximately 2,400 stores and 6,700 points of sales in around 140 countries and employs more than 18,000 people. Together with its sister companies Swarovski Optik (optical devices) and Tyrolit (abrasives), Swarovski Crystal Business forms the Swarovski Group. A responsible relationship with people and the planet is part of Swarovski’s heritage. Today this legacy is rooted in sustainability measures across the value chain, with an emphasis on circular innovation, championing diversity, inclusion and self-expression, and in the philanthropic work of the Swarovski Foundation, which supports charitable organizations bringing positive environmental and social impact.

title: Corporate Communications Specialist
description:
Kaspersky has been protecting individuals and corporate clients all over the world from cyber threats for 27 years.

We have 400 million unique users, 270 000 corporate clients, 517 products, 1100 technological patents and 34 offices around the world.


Today our team has more than 5 000 top level experts, all of them regular people with their own talents and hobbies.

Together we protect the world from cyber threats.


Join us to become part of an exceptional team, while remaining yourself and using your skills to keep us growing and evolving!


As part of the Americas Corporate Communications team, you’ll manage daily PR and social media routines, such as creating content, mapping journalists and influencers, tracking performance, and supporting integrated campaigns.


You’ll also collaborate with marketing and sales (B2B & B2C) and contribute to global initiatives adapted for Brazil.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Content Development

  • Write and review PR materials: press releases, articles, presentations, official statements, FAQs, and fact sheets.
  • Create and adapt content for social media: scripts, copy for visual assets, and digital campaign materials.
  • Draft executive bios and corporate documents (including content for corporate websites and internal portals).
  • Copyedit, proofread, and adapt communications, reports, and translations.
  • Produce and customize media pitches in English and Portuguese.
  • Translate communication materials into English or Portuguese when needed (we work with a translation provider).

2. Strategy and Planning

  • Support the planning, development, and execution of product communication campaigns and corporate projects, integrating traditional and digital channels to promote the company’s brand, products, technologies, and positioning.
  • Collaborate with marketing, product, and expert teams to ensure alignment of messaging and initiatives.
  • Work closely with global corporate communications teams to support media requests, as well as implement global campaigns and projects in the local market.
  • Oversee and coordinate the production of PR and social media materials developed by external agencies and vendors.
  • Contribute ideas and participate in brainstorming for campaigns, events, and special initiatives.

3. Operations and Reporting

  • Manage social media promotion: launching, monitoring, and optimizing campaigns.
  • Support the organization and execution of PR and social media events.
  • Map journalists, influencers, and monitor industry trends.
  • Track media coverage and analyze PR and social media performance metrics.
  • Consolidate and review reports provided by PR and social media agencies across the Americas region – and prepare social media reports as needed.
  • Prepare analyses on the effectiveness of departmental activities and campaigns.
  • Provide support for media outreach and stakeholder engagement when needed.
  • Organize agendas, schedules, and administrative routines related to events and projects.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring deadlines and quality standards are met.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, or related fields.
  • Previous experience in PR or Social Media (minimum of 2 years). Experience in both areas is a plus but not mandatory. Writing/journalism experience is also valued.
  • Excellent writing skills and ability to adapt language for different channels (press, social media, corporate) in Portuguese and English .
  • Desirable understanding of the technology market ;
    strong interest in learning about cybersecurity, innovation, and technology is mandatory.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, ability to supervise partners/agencies, and meet deadlines.
  • Self-motivated individual with the ability to work both in teams and independently.
  • Resourceful, solution-oriented, and able to handle unexpected situations.
  • Must be able to see all assigned tasks through from beginning to end.
  • Fluent English (for interaction with regional and global teams). Spanish is also a plus.
  • Collaborative, proactive, and results-oriented profile.
  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.

title: Head Of Product Design (Ui/Ux, Ai-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor


Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela


About Downstream


Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.


We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.


The Role


We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.


At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.


What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.


Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

title: Corporate Legal Associate
description:
About the Role


We are seeking an Associate to join our corporate legal team at CSBR. In this role, you will work closely with various stakeholders across different departments, providing legal support and reporting directly to the Corporate Legal Counsel. The corporate legal team functions within a dual reporting structure to both the CSBR Country Manager and the Group General Counsel at Saison International, based in Singapore.


The successful candidate will play a key generalist role in providing legal support across all areas of the company, including contract review and drafting, preparation of corporate documents, and delivering legal advice on a range of matters such as compliance, labor, civil, corporate, tax, LGPD and regulatory issues (including matters involving Central Bank of Brazil).


This person will collaborate closely with internal teams — including HR, Finance, Tax, Governance and others — as well as with external professional advisors such as legal counsels and auditors, suppliers and clients.


This position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the development of corporate legal framework, enhance knowledge through implementation of different projects covering different areas of law, and by providing exposure to international multicultural stakeholders.


Main Responsibilities


Legal Advice, Document Drafting and Reviewing


  • Prepare first review, draft and assist corporate legal team to negotiate documents of different areas and variable complexity (such as NDAs, service agreement, engagement letters, software related agreements, employment agreements, head-hunter agreements, lease agreements) ensuring compliance with legal framework, identifying potential risks and providing acceptable mitigation suggestions in a timely manner.
  • Support the Corporate Legal team by analyzing, organizing and aligning comments and changes in contracts reviews with external counsels, key internal and international stakeholders, including the Global Legal & Compliance.
  • Conduct legal research on relevant regulations and case law to support decision making, ensuring contract terms and corporate alignment with latest legal developments and internal policies.
  • Assist corporate legal team in providing tailored legal advice across multiple areas such as corporate governance, labor, tax, civil law and regulatory (including Central Bank matters), ensuring strategic alignment with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
  • Prepare first draft, review and coordinate the execution of corporate resolutions, ensuring that all legally and governance-required elements are accurately reflected in the minutes, while also managing, under the Corporate Legal Counsel’s supervision: (i) submissions to the Central Bank and registrations with the Board of Trade;
    and (ii) registration of the minutes in corporate books, in accordance with local corporate regulation.


General Matters


  • Enhancing internal legal processes, developing standardized templates, performing background checks of services providers, clients and candidates, and implementing best practices to increase efficiency in both legal analysis and compliance.
  • Support Corporate Legal in implementing specific projects related to license application to Central Bank, compliance with LGPD (Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados ) and GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) and corporate tax structuring initiatives.
  • Coordinating cross-functional legal initiatives, preparing materials, improving reporting structures and weekly routines with stakeholders;
  • Collaborate closely with the Governance team by providing legal guidance, reviewing policies and documents to ensure alignment with legal requirements and compliance standards.
  • Coordinate requests for documents to international stakeholders, receipt, translation, notarization and registry with local external counsels and paralegals, in accordance with local regulations.
  • Support the Corporate Legal team by establishing routines to monitor legal updates, sharing relevant information with key stakeholders, assessing potential impacts on the company’s business, and proposing and implementing appropriate solutions.
  • Support knowledge sharing and internal development initiatives through the preparation of materials or participation in training activities



Skills, Experiences & Qualifications


  • 4 - 6 years of post-qualification experience as a Lawyer (preferably some experience working as in-house counsel), desirable experience with corporate, civil, labor and regulatory (Central Bank) law;
  • Bachelor's degree in law;
  • Duly registered with the Brazilian Bar Association (OAB);
  • Strong abilityto manage priorities;
  • Good organization and proactive profile;
  • Clear and objective communication skills for interaction with diverse internal and external stakeholders;
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken);
  • Excellent legal technical skills and strong attention to detail;
  • Solid interpersonal and collaborative abilities.

title: Game Operations Analyst/Senior Analyst
description:
About Garena:

Established in 2009 and headquartered in Singapore, Garena is a leading online games developer and publisher with a global footprint across more than 130 markets.

Garena provides global users access to popular and engaging mobile and PC online games that it develops, curates, and localizes. It champions games as a social and entertainment platform on which its communities can engage and interact.

In addition, Garena is a leading esports organizer. It hosts esports events around the world that range from grassroots local tournaments to some of the most viewed professional esports competitions globally. The Free Fire World Series 2021 Singapore, which was watched by 5.4 million concurrent viewers at its peak, holds the record for the highest concurrent viewership of any esports match in history.



Main Responsibility

Support the strategy and performance of digital game operations, ensuring an excellent player experience while contributing to product evolution and monetization.



Job Description

  • Assist in analyzing player behavior and game performance to suggest improvements in retention, engagement, and monetization.
  • Collaborate on planning in-game events, update cycles, and monetization strategies.
  • Monitor real-time data to identify optimization opportunities.
  • Work alongside product, marketing, and support teams to ensure smooth operations and timely content delivery.
  • Create reports and dashboards tracking key metrics.
  • Research industry benchmarks to support strategic decisions.
  • Present insights and recommendations to internal teams, turning data into actionable strategies across departments.



Our Ideal Candidate

You are a driven and resilient professional who thrives in fast-paced environments and complex challenges. You bring:

  • Passion: A deep enthusiasm for gaming and a fearless curiosity to explore new ideas and territories.
  • Aptitude: A natural ability to quickly learn and master new skills, tools, and methodologies.
  • Drive: Unwavering commitment to overcoming obstacles and pushing boundaries to achieve your goals.



Requirements

  • Bachelor's/Master's degree completed or expected between December 2022 and December 2025 in Engineering, Business, Marketing, Digital Games or other fields
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English
  • Able to work in São Paulo, SP (Hybrid: 3 days in-office, 2 days remote)
  • Able to work in a full-time position (8 hours per day)
  • Passionate about games
  • Knowledge in Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace (Word/Docs, Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint/Slides)



Why Join Us

Join a dynamic team where you will be directly involved in high-impact strategic projects that shape the future of our games and brand. Benefit from personalized mentorship and continuous learning opportunities through close collaboration with our experienced management team. Your creativity and insights will truly matter in an environment that prioritizes your professional growth.
